title: Activation velocity funnel and signal owners
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is a working artifact to track activation velocity (top-to-bottom funnel) tied to specific owner signals, cross-team dependencies, and the lightweight launch readiness checklist. Designed to be sprint-driven (2-week cadence) and to surface blockers with clear triggers for contingency runs.

Executive summary (1 line):
We need to increase First-API-Call conversion by +35% vs baseline within next 3 sprints; blockers: delayed telemetry, quota UX, and missing SDK snippet.

Funnel definition and owner signals:
- Stage 0: Awareness -> owners: growth (Asha Patel) -> signal: marketing click-throughs (UTM), landing CTR >= 6%
- Stage 1: Signup -> owners: product-onboarding (Riley Chen) -> signal: signup-to-verify <= 3m median
- Stage 2: Quickstart run (run quickstart sample) -> owners: devex (Diego Morales) -> signal: quickstart success rate >= 75%
- Stage 3: First API Call -> owners: platform (Liam O'Connor) -> signal: first API call within 10 minutes of signup >= 45%
- Stage 4: 24h active retention -> owners: product (Maya Kapoor) -> signal: 24h active >= 28%

KPIs (baseline / target / current sprint):
- Awareness CTR: 4.2% / 6.5% / 4.8%
- Signup conversion (landing -> signup): 9.8% / 13.0% / 10.6%
- Quickstart success: 58% / 80% / 62%
- First API call rate: 33% / 45% / 36%
- 24h active retention: 22% / 28% / 23%
- Median time to first API call: 42m / 15m / 31m
- Telemetry completeness (events captured): 74% / 95% / 78%

Sprint heatmap (owners rows, sprint columns). Colors encoded as labels (G/R/Y).
Columns: Sprint A (current), Sprint B (next), Sprint C (+2)
- Product (Maya Kapoor): Sprint A: Y (focus retention hooks); Sprint B: G (plan complete); Sprint C: G
- DevEx (Diego Morales): Sprint A: R (SDK snippet missing); Sprint B: Y (fast fixes); Sprint C: G
- Platform (Liam O'Connor): Sprint A: Y (quota flow improvements); Sprint B: G (rollout); Sprint C: G
- Growth (Asha Patel): Sprint A: Y (campaign tweak); Sprint B: G (launch campaign); Sprint C: G
- Observability (Elena Ruiz): Sprint A: R (events gap); Sprint B: Y (patch), Sprint C: G

Top dependencies and blockers (owner, dependency, blocker detail, trigger):
1) Observability / telemetry pipeline (Elena Ruiz) -> missing event: first_api_call_completed -> blocker: sampling/ingestion filter; trigger: telemetry completeness < 85% -> mitigation: roll forward hotfix to pipeline + temporary client-side beacon (Diego to add).
2) SDK quickstart snippet (Diego Morales) -> dependent on docs copy + snippet template -> blocker: docs sign-off delay -> trigger: quickstart success < 70% -> mitigation: ship minimal code snippet + clearly labeled WIP note; devex weekly priority.
3) Quota/limit UX (Liam O'Connor) -> dependent on quota API and frontend -> blocker: race in quota assignment causing 429s -> trigger: median time to first API call > 30m -> mitigation: set permissive temporary free-tier quota and rollback after scale test.
4) Marketing creative (Asha Patel) -> dependent on legal approval -> blocker: creative hold -> trigger: awareness CTR < 5% -> mitigation: fallback creative from prior campaign (Asha).

Launch readiness checklist (Go/No-Go signals must be checked before ramping traffic >10k MAU):
- Telemetry: first_api_call_completed event captured for >85% of quickstarts (owner: Elena) [target: 95%] -> status: at 78% (NO)
- Quickstart sample: documented and runnable in <5 minutes for new user (owner: Diego) -> status: snippet WIP (partial)
- Quota defaults: permissive by default for new signups for first 24h (owner: Liam) -> status: toggled to permissive (YES, temporary)
- Error budget: 95th latency < 800ms on quickstart path (owner: SRE / product) -> status: 95th=610ms (YES)
- Support playbook: two on-call rotations trained for activation issues (owner: customer-success) -> status: scheduled (NO - training pending)
- Rollback plan: can disable campaign and revert quota within 15 minutes (owner: platform) -> status: tested in staging (YES)

Go/No-Go rules (conservative):
- Must have Telemetry YES AND (Quickstart YES OR Quota permissive YES) AND Support playbook YES to fully ramp. If telemetry is NO but all others YES, proceed to limited beta (~1k MAU) with active manual monitoring.

Contingency playbooks (short):
- If telemetry < 80%: stop new user traffic, flip temporary client-side beacon mode, redispatch events to fallback ingestion (runtime patch), notify on-call observability.
- If quickstart success < 60%: enable in-product guided walkthrough (manual steps), surface banner to new users with direct support link, pause marketing.
- If first API call latency > 1200ms P95: divert traffic to lower-latency region and throttle token throughput for ephemeral jobs.

Action items (owners, due dates):
- Diego: ship minimal quickstart snippet + integration test (due: 2024-11-19) -> status: in progress
- Elena: complete telemetry hotfix, validate event coverage to 95% (due: 2024-11-21) -> status: in progress
- Liam: keep permissive quota toggle live and add rollback script (due: 2024-11-14) -> status: done
- Asha: prepare fallback campaign creative and sign-off path (due: 2024-11-18) -> status: blocked by legal
- Maya: coordinate support playbook training slots (due: 2024-11-22) -> status: scheduled

Risks & notes to self (raw):
- We are comfortable taking data risk (telemetry gaps) to hit activation, but we must be explicit in docs and runbook who owns missing metrics and how to backfill.
- Consider temporary manual instrumentation on a subset of accounts for ground-truth while pipeline roll is fixed.
- Need to decide whether to make quota permissive permanently; recommend timeboxed 2-week window with postmortem.
- Put simple dashboard metric "first_api_call_funnel_leak" (owners: product+observability) to catch regressions quickly.

Open questions (for sync):
- Legal turn time for final creative approval — Asha to confirm by 2024-11-13.
- Who owns support training sign-off (customer-success lead?) — Maya to sequence and get dates.
- Do we want to treat first_api_call within 10m as the canonical SLA for activation? (proposal: yes for early adopters)

Short-term meeting cadence:
- Weekly activation standup (30m): owners only, Wed 10:00 PT (agenda: metrics pulse, blockers, decisions) -> invite: ProductOps, DevEx, Platform, Observability, Growth, CS
- Ad-hoc telem triage as needed when telemetry completeness drops below 85%.

Appendix (quick references):
- Quickstart repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts
- Telemetry confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=987654
- Related tickets: PROJ-457 (telemetry pipeline fix), PROJ-503 (quickstart snippet), PROJ-489 (quota UX)

"Notes to self": keep this sheet lean — move stable metrics to the dashboard AND keep step-by-step contingency playbooks in a separate runbook for on-call. This is the sprint-level coordination doc.
